title: Schedule of Homeowner Charges, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Each HomeCare program of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries its own emergency dispatch fee, missed-appointment fee, number of free missed appointments, reinspection fee and structural deductible. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Program | Emergency dispatch fee | Missed-appointment fee | Free missed appointments over the life of the coverage | Reinspection fee | Structural deductible per approved structural claim item |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | USD 150.00 | USD 95.00 | 0 | USD 125.00 | USD 250.00 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | USD 150.00 | USD 95.00 | 0 | USD 125.00 | USD 250.00 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | USD 150.00 | USD 75.00 | 1 | USD 125.00 | USD 250.00 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | USD 125.00 | USD 75.00 | 1 | USD 100.00 | USD 0.00 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | USD 100.00 | USD 50.00 | 1 | USD 100.00 | USD 0.00 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | USD 100.00 | USD 0.00 | 2 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 |

**What each column is.**
- *Emergency dispatch fee* — the program's fee figure for an emergency dispatch that finds a condition caused by the homeowner or not covered.
- *Missed-appointment fee* — the program's fee figure for a missed appointment beyond the free missed appointments.
- *Free missed appointments* — the number of missed appointments over the life of the coverage that carry no fee.
- *Reinspection fee* — the program's fee figure for re-measuring an item already denied as within tolerance that is again found within tolerance.
- *Structural deductible* — the deductible per approved structural claim item.

**Observations drawn from the table.**
- HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve carries no missed-appointment fee, no reinspection fee and no structural deductible, and allows two free missed appointments.
- The structural deductible is USD 250.00 in the three lower programs and USD 0.00 from HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred upward.
